lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots located posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots to create a characteristic grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge feature running along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near its anterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several commensal organisms (remoras) located near the ventral-pectoral interface and lower head region.
